class: organizer gate defect; no scoring, qualification or execution rule is touched
defect: The certificate and risk-declaration validators looked for the bare string 'replace', case-insensitively. That fires inside the ordinary English word 'replaced', so a lane was rejected for writing 'both changes chosen to be more principled than the ones they replaced'.
family: Third defect of one kind: a gate that rejects honest work. A1 rejected any source naming the repository's own path; this rejected ordinary English. Both were found by looking at what the gate did to real inputs rather than at whether its tests passed.
fix: Markers are now the exact placeholders the shipped templates carry -- REPLACE-ME and REPLACE: -- matched case-sensitively and with their delimiters. The unedited templates are still refused, which is checked, and prose may contain the word 'replaced', which is also checked.
found_by: the organizer, pre-validating every lane's nomination inputs before committing hours of replay to them
